title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda Tropical Twist 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Tropical Twist from Doozy Vape Co’s Seriously Soda collection delivers a rush of sun-ripened Pineapple to your tastebuds, shot through with sweet-sour lemons for a zesty finish that’s lifted further with a light soda rush for the most exquisite refreshment. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks.
